"Ungültiger Aufruf. Der IT-Gesamtplan für das Jahr 2027 existiert nicht." — because setup-docu-data deletes gesamtplan >= 2027. That's why. The test flow requires 030's first test to create the 2027 plan. So the 030 chain: test1 creates 2027, test2 uses it. In the run above test1 passed and test2 failed at checkbox fp-9901 not found — because 9901 was deleted by setup-docu-data and only recreated by 01-infra spec. In the "full sequence" run, 01 created 99/9901, 030 test1 created 2027 plan, then test2... let me look at the ordered run: 030 had 1 passing (test1) and failing test2. Hmm.

Wait in the ordered run 01-infra ran first and created 99 and 9901. Then 030 test1 created plan 2027. Then test2 failed on `.alert-info` not visible (the d-none hint div). Actually the error in ordered run was: "expected '<div.alert.alert-info.mb-4.d-none>' to be 'visible'". That means the checkbox WAS found and clicked, POST submitted, but then the assertion `.alert-info` matched the static hint div (d-none) instead of a success message. Actually the success message also has class alert-info but... Let me check: addHtmlMessage with 'info' produces alert-info. But the static hint div is also alert-info and appears first. Cypress `.should('be.visible')` on first match fails. Hmm, but in a working scenario the success message div would appear too, and cy.get('.alert-info') returns all matches; should('be.visible') checks... actually cy.get returns multiple and should applies to each? It would fail if any is not visible? No — assertions on multiple elements apply to all. Actually `.should('be.visible')` on multiple elements requires all to be visible. The d-none hint div is never visible. So that test would ALWAYS fail? Unless the success path returns early before rendering the form (return; after addHtmlMessage), so the form template isn't rendered and the d-none div doesn't appear.

In FachplanungenNeu constructor, on POST success it calls addFachPlanung which calls addHtmlMessage. It does NOT return — it continues to render the template. So the d-none hint div would be present. Hmm, but wait: after POST, $data['vorhanden'] includes 9901, so it renders checkbox checked. The d-none div is still there. So `.alert-info` matches both. That suggests the test as written would fail. Unless addHtmlMessage creates message outside main content and the static div... let me actually check by getting a successful POST.

The reason my manual POST failed with "Gesamtplan 2027 existiert nicht" is that setup-docu-data deleted 2027 earlier, and the ordered 030 test1 created it—but I then re-ran setup-docu-data before infra.
